```plato

    // The arc-length integrand of the local-frame graph y = b (1 - (x/a)^n)^(1/n):
    // sqrt(1 + (dy/dx)^2) with dy/dx = -(b/a) (x/a)^(n-1) (1 - (x/a)^n)^(1/n - 1).
    // Bounded and smooth on the segment used below (where (x/a)^n <= 1/2), so the
    // Simpson rule in `SuperEllipseArcSegment` converges cleanly. Precondition:
    // Exponent >= 1 (below 1 the tangent is vertical AT the axis and the graph
    // integrand is unbounded there).
    SuperEllipseArcIntegrand(a: Number, b: Number, n: Number, x: Number): Number
        => (1.0 + ((b / a) * (x / a).Pow(n - 1.0)
                   * (1.0 - (x / a).Pow(n)).Pow(1.0 / n - 1.0)).Square).Sqrt;
```
